app.name: Settle Quest
app.tagline: Settlement steps for international students at a regional university

legal.short: Administrative information only. This has no legal force.
legal.long: This service organises publicly available government information. It has no legal force and does not replace a decision about your own situation. Confirm with the responsible office or the Immigration Contact Center (1345) before you apply.

onboarding.title: Three things first
onboarding.why: Which steps you need and when they are due depend on your nationality, status and entry date. What you enter stays on this device and is never sent to a server.
onboarding.registrationDate: Date of alien registration (if you know it)
onboarding.registrationHint: Used to work out your health insurance start date. It is fine to leave this empty.

quest.softNote: Doing this first gives you more options

freshness.warning: This guidance is past its review date. Confirm directly with the office.
freshness.changedWarning: The source page has changed. Do not rely on this guidance until a person has reviewed it.
freshness.coverageWhy: This number shows how current the product actually is. When it is low, it is shown low.

documents.title: Document helper
documents.why: Reads the machine-readable zone (MRZ) of your passport and fills the matching fields of Korean forms. The image is processed on this device and never leaves it.
documents.failed: Could not read the MRZ. Please type the values below.
documents.suggestions: It may have been read as
documents.koreanNameHint: The Korean spelling is not generated for you. A wrong transliteration gets forms rejected, so please type it yourself.
documents.clearConfirm: This deletes everything saved on this device. Continue?
documents.storageNote: Saved values live only in this browser. Nothing is stored on a server.

support.title: Public support desks
support.why: This service does not broker professionals or take referral fees. It only organises publicly available information about public desks.

ask.title: Ask
ask.why: Answers come only from the rules. Each answer shows which rule and which line it came from, and when that information was last checked. Your question never leaves this device.
ask.placeholder: e.g. How long do I have to register?
ask.uncertainNote: It is not certain this answers your question. Please check the text below yourself.
ask.unknownTitle: This question cannot be answered here
ask.unknownNote: No supporting text was found in the rules. Rather than invent an answer, we say we do not know. The Immigration Contact Center (1345) counsels in 20 languages.
